title: salmea scandens var. genuina
intro: Salmea scandens var. genuina, commonly known as the False Hamelia, is a plant species in the family Acanthaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Salmea scandens var. genuina include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of fever and respiratory issues.
